terms.comment: A town takes no preposition: Belgradum (to), Belgradī (in, at), Belgradō (from).

evidence: Sulp. Sev. Chron. 2.38.3: ā Singidūnō Ursatius
Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Belgrad: Singidunum, Taurunum
terms.comment: The ancient name, in late writers (Sulpicius Severus, the Notitia dignitatum); Lewis & Short has no entry for it. The long ū is Morgan–Owens’s marking.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).

J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus (Dresden, 1861), German–Latin index, read in the scan at archive.org (the 1909 edition at columbia.edu could not be reached page by page); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
The Latin Library texts (thelatinlibrary.com), read in a local copy, for ancient passages not quoted in Lewis & Short; cited by book and section.
